title: Shark Fishing Adventure in Murrells Inlet, SC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
An exhilarating shark fishing adventure awaits just off the coast of Murrells Inlet, South Carolina. Set out on a 4-hour nearshore trip where anglers of all skill levels can target Atlantic Sharpnose Sharks only 3–5 miles offshore, with action starting quickly once lines are in the water.

Our experienced crew provides all rods, reels, bait, and tackle, along with step-by-step guidance to ensure a safe, fun, and successful experience for beginners and seasoned anglers alike. Once hooked, feel the adrenaline rush as you battle these powerful ocean predators right from the deck.

Along the way, enjoy beautiful coastal views, steady action, and a hands-on fishing experience designed for excitement and memories. This family-friendly shark fishing trip is perfect for anyone looking to try something different on the water and bring home an unforgettable story.
